Class BuildingCard

java.lang.Object
mesos.am30.gameModel.card.Card
mesos.am30.gameModel.card.BuildingCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class BuildingCard extends Card
Representation of a Building Card.
This Class works as the representation for a Building Card, independently of its type of Event.

  • Constructor Details

    • BuildingCard

      public BuildingCard(int era, int id, IF_Event event, EventType eventType, int foodCost, int ppGain)
      Constructor of a Building Card.
      Pre: 1 <= era <= 4 && id > 1 && event != null && eventType != null && foodCost > 0 && ppGainEnd >= 0
      Post: this.era = era && this.id = id && this.event = event && this.eventType = eventType && this.foodCost = foodCost && this.ppGainEnd = ppGainEnd
      Parameters:
      era - Era when the Card is draw.
      id - Unique ID of the Card.
      event - Event assigned to the Card.
      eventType - Specific type of the Event.
      foodCost - Cost in food of the Card.
      ppGain - Number of PP (Prestige Points) gained at the end of the Game by having this Card.
